mechanism: Alendronate causes esophageal irritation and delayed gastric emptying, while isocarboxazid (MAOI) increases risk of orthostatic hypotension and upper GI complications; combined effect increases GI adverse event risk and syncope potential.
action: Monitor for orthostatic symptoms and severe GI distress; ensure alendronate is taken with full glass of water in upright position; consider alternative osteoporosis therapy if MAOI use is essential.
